_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Loki egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Loki
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Loki stores and searches logs, like Prometheus does metrics; agents such as Grafana Alloy send it the logs. Its settings are in loki.yaml.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Loki: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub and checks
# its checksum. loki.yaml and the data folder are never touched; only the
# loki program is replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac

want="${LOKI_VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag grafana/loki "$tag") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.5.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"
name="loki-linux-$arch.zip"

if [ -x loki ] && ./loki -version 2>/dev/null | grep "version $version " >/dev/null; then
    echo "Loki $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Loki $version"
    gh-release download grafana/loki "$tag" "$name" $work/loki.zip
    unzip -q -o $work/loki.zip -d $work/loki
    chmod +x "$work/loki/loki-linux-$arch"
    mv -f "$work/loki/loki-linux-$arch" loki.new && mv -f loki.new loki
    rm -rf $work/loki $work/loki.zip
fi

mkdir -p data
if [ ! -f loki.yaml ]; then
    cat > loki.yaml <<'EOF'
# Loki's settings: https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/configure/
# The port is set from the server's own port each time it starts.
auth_enabled: false

server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
  grpc_listen_port: 9096
  log_level: info

common:
  instance_addr: 127.0.0.1
  path_prefix: data
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: data/chunks
      rules_directory: data/rules
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory

query_range:
  results_cache:
    cache:
      embedded_cache:
        enabled: true
        max_size_mb: 100

schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: 2020-10-24
      store: tsdb
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v13
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h
EOF
fi
echo "Installed Loki $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Loki version to install, such as 3.5.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Usage reports
variables.description: Send anonymous usage statistics to Grafana Labs (true or false).
